# `akb init .` outside a repository: a standalone repository at the current
# directory, with the KB name derived from the directory's basename and
# reported back at exit 0.

env GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=2
env GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=user.name
env GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=ambient
env GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=user.email
env GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1=ambient@local

mkdir project
cd project

exec akb init .
stdout '^Initialized KB "project" at .*/project$'

exists .git
exists kb/index.md
exists .agent-kb/akb.yaml
grep '^name: project$' .agent-kb/akb.yaml
grep '^versioning: git$' .agent-kb/akb.yaml

# The adopted name reaches the init commit as well.
exec git log -1 --format=%s
stdout '^akb: init project$'

exec akb status
stdout '^Name: project$'
stdout '^Git: clean$'
